title: 第五十五章 异怪第五十四章 破冰
lines: 异变突生。
峡谷两侧的峭壁之上，忽然爬出一只只八足巨蝎，每一只都比山地精更大，甲缝里支棱出狰狞的骨刺，尾钩淬着冷光，伴随它们的行进低颤。
它们的复眼盯住峡谷下方幼龙，挥舞着青灰色的甲钳，毫不犹豫冲了过来。
“哪来这么多蝎子？”
莫奇鳞片倒竖，左右顾盼，发现竟然有二三十头之多，下意识把西隆护到身前。
他的问题无人回答，三只巨蝎贴着崖壁疾掠而下，碎石被节肢蹬得簌簌乱飞，来得又快又急，眨眼间便已经到了近前。
克莱利径直走上去迎击。
双方接近，巨蝎竟然弹跳起来，往半空中一闪，挥舞着甲钳往龙身上猛夹，它们的甲钳上尽是锯齿状的倒钩，要是夹中，也不知道要掉下多少肉来。
钴龙不假思索，忽然转过身去。
克莱利的巨尾一掀一砸，仿佛攻城锤一样的尾巴重击，精准命中巨蝎，把它从半空中拍落，甲壳崩裂坍陷，青绿色的浆液暴溅出来。
“还好，大概四级灾害。”
克莱利瓮声瓮气的说，漆黑的瞳孔环视：“只是数量有点太多了。”
另一只巨蝎冲向莫奇和西隆所在，莫奇龇牙咧嘴，刚想对扑，西隆已经大步向前。
这些巨蝎明显智慧不高，攻击却十分刁钻，西隆刚一接近，它的尾钩便破开空气呼啸，直扎西隆的头颅，同时节肢沉下蓄力、甲钳张开，要在西隆躲闪的瞬间去夹他的颈脖。
可是西隆并不躲闪，他的眼睛里流光掠影，把尾钩进攻的轨迹看得一清二楚，轻描淡写的错身而过，探出爪趾，抠进巨蝎甲壳之间的缝隙，一拉一扯，把巨蝎的半边甲壳都剥下来。
力量恰到好处。
异怪歪在地上，抽搐着不动了。
下一个瞬间，镍龙猛扑出击，却不是朝着蝎群，而是扑向山地精的头领。
谁都没有想到镍龙会突然袭击，亚兹也根本全无防备。
不过他毕竟是蛮骨氏族最强大的战士，反应比思考更快，当即原地翻滚，翻滚结束的时候，把对着蝎群的刀刃反转过来，抵住了镍龙凌空而下的獠牙。
双方短暂的对抗，亚兹的力量反倒更胜一筹，架住镍龙的獠牙缓缓向外推。
镍龙脸上凶相毕露，喉咙猛然滚动，就要吐息。
“停手，比多。”
西隆刚刚收拾完第三只巨蝎，抽身回退：“你在做什么？”
一句话的时机，亚兹脚下猛然一踹，配合骨刀上的力量，将镍龙掀得前翻出去，自己也赶紧站起来，佝偻着身，持刀戒备。
“西隆老大，这些山地精把我们引到这里来，是个陷阱，我们被埋伏了！”
比多脸上的神情阴狠扭曲：“我先宰了他！”
“不是我！”
亚兹声音凝重又急迫，他也知道这些异怪来的时机过于巧合，一时半会，恐怕解释不清。
比多根本不听卑贱的山地精解释，自己的话音落下，毫不迟疑再度扑出，刚要对亚兹挥爪，又被另一道身影在半空中截断。
哗啦啦。
莫奇和比多翻滚在一起，双方脸贴着脸互相瞪视，喉咙里不约而同发出低吼，獠牙毕露。
连莫奇也露出了狰狞的凶相。
content_en:
Sudden changes occur.
On the cliffs on both sides of the canyon, eight-legged giant scorpions suddenly crawled out. Each one was larger than the mountain goblin, with ferocious bone spurs protruding from the seams of their armor, and their tail hooks were quenched with cold light, trembling as they moved forward.
Their compound eyes were fixed on the young dragon below the canyon, waving their blue-gray claws, they rushed over without hesitation.
"Where did so many scorpions come from?"
Mo Qi's scales stood upright. He looked around and found that there were twenty or thirty of them. He subconsciously protected Xi Long in front of him.
There was no answer to his question. Three giant scorpions swooped down the cliff, and the gravel was kicked off by their jointed limbs. They came quickly and urgently, and they were already close in the blink of an eye.
Clery walked straight up to meet him.
As the two sides approached, the giant scorpion jumped up, dodged in mid-air, and swung its claws to clamp down on the dragon. Their claws were full of jagged barbs. If they were caught, no one knew how much meat would fall out.
Without thinking, Cobalt Dragon suddenly turned around.
Clary's giant tail was lifted and smashed, and the tail hit hard like a battering ram, accurately hitting the giant scorpion and knocking it out of the air. The carapace cracked and collapsed, and the green slurry splashed out.
"Fortunately, it's probably a level four disaster."
Clary said angrily, looking around with dark pupils: "It's just that the number is a bit too much."
Another giant scorpion rushed towards where Moqi and Shillong were. Moqi bared his teeth and was about to attack, but Shillong was already striding forward.
These giant scorpions were obviously not very intelligent, but their attacks were very cunning. As soon as Shillong approached, its tail hook roared through the air and pierced Shillong's head. At the same time, its jointed limbs sank down to accumulate power, and its claws opened to pinch Shillong's neck the moment he dodged.
But Shillong did not dodge. His eyes flashed, and he clearly saw the trajectory of the tail hook's attack. He passed by lightly, stretched out his claw toes, dug into the gaps between the giant scorpion's carapace, and pulled and peeled off half of the giant scorpion's carapace.
Just the right amount of power.
The strange creature was lying on the ground, twitching and motionless.
"Roar!"
The next moment, the Nickel Dragon pounced, not toward the scorpions, but toward the leader of the mountain goblins.
No one expected that the Nickel Dragon would suddenly attack, and Yaz was totally unprepared.
But after all, he was the most powerful warrior of the Barbarian Bone Clan, and his reaction was faster than his thinking. He immediately rolled on the spot. When the roll was over, he turned the blade facing the scorpion group and resisted the fangs of the nickel dragon flying down.
There was a brief confrontation between the two sides, but Yaz's strength was stronger. He held the nickel dragon's fangs and slowly pushed it outward.
Nickel Dragon's face showed a fierce look, his throat rolled suddenly, and he was about to exhale.
"Stop, Bedo."
Shillong had just finished taking care of the third giant scorpion and stepped back: "What are you doing?"
At the right moment, Yaz kicked his foot suddenly, and combined with the power of the bone knife, he flipped the nickel dragon forward, and he quickly stood up, hunched over, holding the knife on guard.
"Boss Shillong, these mountain goblins led us here. It was a trap. We were ambushed!"
The look on Biduo's face was sinister and twisted: "I'll kill him first!"
"Not me!"
Yaz's voice was solemn and urgent. He also knew that the timing of the arrival of these strange creatures was too coincidental, and he might not be able to explain it for a while.
Bido didn't listen to the humble mountain goblin's explanation at all. After his words fell, he jumped out again without hesitation. Just as he was about to swing his claw at Yaz, he was intercepted by another figure in mid-air.
Crash.
Mochi and Bido rolled together, staring at each other face to face, growling in unison in their throats, and showing their fangs.
Even Mo Qi showed a ferocious look.
